description: Approximate playback of Inspire six-register hand commands on Wuji Hand 2 joints. Visualization proxy for Inspire-recorded demonstrations, not a retargeting result.
self_collision_check: No Wuji finger self-penetration over 1 mm for any of the 3^6 register combinations {0, 500, 1000} on either hand (2026-10-21).
thumb_rotation_note: Register 1000 is the open hand (thumb in the palm plane); thumb_rotation_rad applies at register 0.
